note: Real photos of labels, for what the scan photo reads off one unit: its lot (#3792) and the year it was made (#3802). Each one's cross-check answer is recorded once beside it (<file>.crosscheck.json) by scripts/record-label-lot-cassettes.ts and replayed in CI.

photos.why: A real ball band: COLOR 228 beside DYE-LOT 5293, the lot's last digit cut off at the frame's edge. The lot is not the colour number.

photos.why: A real trilingual label: DYE LOT / TEINTURE / LOTE DEL TINTE with its numbers on other lines. Which number is the lot is not certain from the picture, so the assertion is only that a lot read here is one of the printed numbers and never the colour number 11108.

photos.why: Skeins with no label in frame: nothing is printed, so no lot may be read (downscaled to 1024 px wide).

photos.why: A Sauternes label that prints three years: Fondé en 1709, Grand Cru Classé en 1855, and the vintage 2008. Only the vintage is the year this bottle was made.
photos.title: File:Chateau filhot 2008 bottle label.jpg
photos.author: Gabriel de Vaucelles

photos.why: A whole bottle: the vintage 1998 on the neck label beside a handwritten bottle count and a bottle number, the front label with no year at all.

photos.why: A label photographed at an angle on the bottle, the vintage 2004 above a postcode (33330).
